page.notes: Ciernum[?]: doubtful reading, probably a proper name (Cleanthes, Diogenes' correspondent). "feRIeris" is printed as "fe-rieris" with the hyphen at the line end; the text is copied as printed. A blot sits over the word "inferior" and the line below it; it is a stain, not text. "suc-" at the line end is hyphenated and continues into the catchword "cum". The printed "valore" and "Resp. 3." are copied as printed.
